build_cuda_extension: build the MultiScaleDeformableAttention CUDA extension by running python setup.py install with CUDA available
run_setup_install: run python setup.py install to compile and install the MultiScaleDeformableAttention PyTorch extension module
get_extensions_function: call get_extensions to return a list of CUDA extension modules for MultiScaleDeformableAttention
review_get_extensions: review the get_extensions function that detects CUDA availability and configures compile arguments
refactor_get_extensions: refactor get_extensions to support CPU-only builds instead of raising NotImplementedError when CUDA is unavailable
